chapter.heading: 2 Corinthians 13
Final Warnings
chapter.v: by the evidence of two or three witnesses.
if I come again I will not spare them—
we will live with him by the power of God.
Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you fail to meet the test!
I hope you will find out that we have not failed the test.
But we pray to God that you may not do wrong—not that we may appear to have met the test, but that you may do what is right, though we may seem to have failed.
For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.
restoration is what we pray for.
the authority that the Lord has given me for building up and not for tearing down.
Greet one another with a holy kiss.
the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all.
